title: 11 Lazy Ways To Make Money With AI (No Experience)
summary: A creator ranks AI side hustles in a tier list, rating his own e-commerce and digital-product models top while pitching his free course.

assertions.quote: The scalability is dang near infinite.
Now, we can use tools like Claude to spin up these PDFs and make them look extremely professional
this thing makes money while you sleep

verdicts.note: A third-party estimate over about 4M Gumroad products finds roughly one in forty has ever recorded a sale and the median seller grosses under $100 over the product's whole life, so years of passive income from one product is the rare exception (estimated from public data, method not published).

In a six-month crawl of about 160,000 Google Play apps and 87,000 new releases, 74-78% had fewer than 1,000 downloads, so most digital products built and listed get little uptake (downloads, not income, and apps rather than info products).

assertions.quote: test a bunch of different industries and ideas until you eventually find one that pops off

verdicts.note: Affiliate commission income is heavily skewed: a few creators earn large sums while most affiliates earn little or nothing.
